title: orchis patens subsp. brevicornis
intro: Orchis patens subsp. brevicornis, commonly known as the Short-horned Orchid, is a plant species in the orchid family that is native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Orchis patens subsp. brevicornis include its ability to calm the nervous system and relieve symptoms of anxiety and insomnia, making it a popular ingredient in traditional herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in pharmaceutical and cosmetic applications.
